title.value: A BILL FOR AN ACT Relating to PFAS
title.provenance: A BILL FOR AN ACT Relating to PFAS.

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance means a substance included in a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom, also commonly known as PFAS.

type.provenance: A person may not manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute in or into this state a new covered product that contains an intentionally added perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance.

who.provenance: A manufacturer of a covered product shall provide to a person that offers a covered product for sale in this state with a certificate of compliance stating that the covered product does not contain any intentionally added perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances.

action.provenance: A person may not manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute in or into this state a new covered product that contains an intentionally added perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance.

products.provenance: Covered product means any of the following products, including any of the products' components: aqueous film-forming foam; artificial turf; cleaning products; carpets or rugs; cookware; cosmetics; dental floss; fabric treatments; packaging; juvenile products; menstrual products; refrigerators; textile articles.

value: sale or resale of used covered products
exceptions.provenance: A section does not apply to the sale or resale of used covered products.

intentionally_added.provenance: Intentionally added perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance means a perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance found in or on a covered product: that serves an intended function in the covered product; that is the intended result of a chemical reaction during the manufacture of the covered product; or that is a by-product of a process used to manufacture the covered product, including the use of processing agents, mold release agents or fluorination, if the manufacturer knew or should have known that the process would introduce the perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance into or on the covered product.

type.provenance: Beginning January 1, 2032, a person may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute for sale in this state any product that contains intentionally added PFAS, unless the commissioner has determined by rule that the use of PFAS in the product is a currently unavoidable use.

value: sale or resale of a used product
exceptions.provenance: (d) The commissioner may not take action under paragraph (b) or (c) with respect to a pesticide, as defined under chapter 18B, a fertilizer, an agricultural liming material, a plant amendment, or a soil amendment as defined under chapter 18C, unless the commissioner of agriculture approves the action. This section does not apply to: (1) a product for which federal law governs the presence of PFAS in the product in a manner that preempts state authority; (2) a product regulated under section 325F.072 or 325F.075; or (3) the sale or resale of a used product.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: Beginning January 1, 2032, a person may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute for sale in this state any product that contains intentionally added PFAS, unless the commissioner has determined by rule that the use of PFAS in the product is a currently unavoidable use.
